title: Remarks at Chapman, Kansas
paragraphs: I want to say what a pleasure it has been to come through Kansas, to be greeted by the older men who did so well in the great days, and to see the younger men and be willing to guarantee that they will do as well if ever the need arises. I am glad to see you, men and women and boys and girls. I believe in you with all my heart. I wish you well.
At Chapman, Kansas, the President was presented with a foot-ball. In accepting it he said:

"That shall serve as the text for the sixty seconds I have here. Adopt for life the same rule that I am sure my friend here acts on in the foot-ball field; do not flinch, do not foul, and hit the line hard."
